decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-3eeced8aa0464e669495e4774e6c0a2a and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control. A new regression test protects that contrast. All 7 page tests, 62 directly related tests, and 938 repository tests pass with 3 platform-limited skips; the unchanged final full-suite rerun completed in 163 seconds. One initial related-suite invocation omitted the documented repository module path and produced two import errors; the corrected command passed without changing tests. Before pause, task and repository governance had no deterministic failures; scope accepted all five task-owned paths and rejected six preserved prior-task or user-owned paths without granting an exception. A bounded current-Agent advisory review found the human authority, status vocabulary, frozen Landing, and local-only boundaries preserved and does not claim native self-review or independence. The latest user-reported one-minute, two-of-three M3 result is recorded only as the correction input because Codex did not observe it or verify the reader condition. No Git, hosting, publication, localization, release, deployment, or Landing action is authorized. The task is paused for a different unbriefed-reader product review.
